Policy: Only APIs with a verified runtime data contract may leave quarantine.

AddNormalItem.Rejected: Every other genre, including IBItem genre 8.

NativeContracts.IsExistItem: Counts owned items by the mapped VNG table identity, including stack size.
NativeContracts.GetNpcLevel: Returns Npc[index].m_Level for a bounded runtime NPC index.
NativeContracts.ThrowItem: Creates and drops only the same verified genre 3/4/6 normal-item tuples; the unverified ninth bind flag is rejected.
NativeContracts.TaskNote: Projects VNG task id, step and dynamic arguments through the existing UI_NOTEINFO journal protocol without changing its ordinal.
NativeContracts.FinishNpcCollection: Reads the official VNG \settings\npccollection.txt rows and emits the completed collection record.
NativeContracts.SayTask: Reads VNG nested option rows {label, callback; show=n} and exposes only enabled callbacks.
NativeContracts.JEMainTaskComplete: Persists 128 Justice/Evil main-task completion bits in locked task values 4996-4999.

BlockedDataContracts.AddEventItem: No verified eventitem.txt payload is available.
BlockedDataContracts.AddTotemNpc: Summon/totem ownership and skill-target contract is not yet verified.
BlockedDataContracts.SetAIScript: AI script field and lifecycle contract is not yet verified.
BlockedDataContracts.Getskill_eventskilllevel: Event-skill level registry contract is not yet verified.
BlockedDataContracts.AddMyTrap: VNG trap signature and ownership semantics do not match legacy AddTrap.
